preregistration: O1 — first response oracle on the confirmed C1 niche
status: FROZEN — declared before any O1 training data existed

authorised_by.what_it_established: Among opportunity-matched leads, greater home threat reliably predicts failure to preserve the lead across independent evaluation samples.
authorised_by.what_it_did_NOT_establish: Any mechanism. O1 is a search for whether PPO discovers a useful alternative response, not an implementation of a named response.

c1_predicate.drift_guard: tests/test_c1_context.py::test_batched_predicate_matches_the_confirmed_one — 120 randomised states covering every branch of home_threatened

clauses.red_carrying_blue_flag: red agent 0 carrying; blue_flag_pos attached to carrier

randomisation.why: O1 must see the C1 region, not one memorised state

pod_defend_lead_rejected.reason_1: POD_DEFEND_LEAD places both blue agents adjacent to their own flag; C1 requires both past the midline. The confirmed context is blue leading and OUT of position, the pod is blue leading and already home.
pod_defend_lead_rejected.reason_2: Its clock line guards on core.decision_step, which does not exist on BatchedCTFCore (the counter is step_count), so it never set the late clock it documents. Its max_decision_steps lookup likewise never read the configured horizon.
pod_defend_lead_rejected.reason_3: The V6I26 phase-pod family is the birth attempt that produced distinct z indices with indistinguishable behaviour.

declared_validity_limitation.clock: step_count left at 0, so an injected C1 has a full 240-step horizon a natural mid-episode C1 does not. The frozen construction says nothing about the clock and inventing one would add a free parameter.
declared_validity_limitation.prefix: A natural C1 is reached by play; an injected one is not.
declared_validity_limitation.mitigation: EVERY gate is scored on natural, uninjected episodes. The injector buys training density and influences nothing else.

training.warm_start_rationale: Warm-starting from G0 reaches competence faster but biases O1 toward G0's behaviour — the exact direction in which gate 4 failed in V6I22, V6I26 and K=2.
training.reward: locked Reward V5, identical constants to artifacts/g0_v5_long/G0_V5_LONG_RUN_SPEC.json
training.reward_shaping_for_role: NONE — no role bonus, no z label, no DEFEND/RECOVER/ROTATE_HOME term
training.primary_evidence_rule: the 1,000,000-step checkpoint is the ONLY primary evidence; intermediate checkpoints are health monitoring and may never be promoted after the fact

evaluation.arm_B: G0 until C1_active first true at t*, then O1 to the horizon
evaluation.why_paired: identical seed means identical trajectory up to t*; everything after t* is attributable to the handoff

selector.granularity: within-episode, one-way, switching at first C1 onset
selector.departure_rationale: C1 is a mid-episode state; a per-episode selector could not see the context that was actually confirmed
selector.per_episode_variant: reported as a secondary diagnostic; does not gate

minimum_support.below_threshold_verdict: INSUFFICIENT — not a failure and not a pass

gate_1_o1_owns_c1.population: natural episodes in which C1_active fires
gate_1_o1_owns_c1.metric_rationale: the exact failure C1 was confirmed against
gate_1_o1_owns_c1.statistic: P(preserve | arm B) - P(preserve | arm A), paired on (opponent, seed)
gate_1_o1_owns_c1.pass: delta >= 0.10 AND 95% CI excludes 0, in >= 2 of 3 O1 seeds

gate_2_g0_retains_an_anchor.population: natural episodes in which C1_active never fires
gate_2_g0_retains_an_anchor.metric: win rate, full-episode G0 vs full-episode O1, same seeds
gate_2_g0_retains_an_anchor.pass: WR(O1, anchor) <= WR(G0, anchor) + 0.05, in >= 2 of 3 O1 seeds
gate_2_g0_retains_an_anchor.why_being_better_is_a_failure: An O1 that dominates everywhere is a better generalist, not a complementary specialist. The correct response would be to replace G0, not to birth z1.

gate_3_selector_beats_best_fixed.compare: WR(selector) vs max(WR(G0 always), WR(O1 always))
gate_3_selector_beats_best_fixed.pass: margin >= 0.05 AND 95% CI on (selector - best fixed) excludes 0, in >= 2 of 3 O1 seeds

gate_4_behaviour_is_distinct.observation_bank: natural C1 onset states; byte-identical observations for every compared policy; identical legal-action masking; balanced across G0-generated and O1-generated states
gate_4_behaviour_is_distinct.d_policy_rejected: D_policy = mean(between) - mean(within) tests 'are these networks different at all', not 'are they meaningfully different'. It passed on a checkpoint that had completely collapsed into a single dominant generalist.
gate_4_behaviour_is_distinct.unstable_seed_rationale: If a weak O1 seed inflates within-family variation enough to fail this gate, O1 is not behaviourally coherent enough to serve as a latent branch. That is a finding.

retention_rule.all_four_pass: O1 retained; z0 = G0, z1 = O1; latent birth unlocks
retention_rule.any_gate_fails: O1 NOT retained; z1 NOT born
retention_rule.insufficient_support: INSUFFICIENT; rerun with more evaluation seeds, change nothing else
retention_rule.birth_is_separate: Forcing z0 vs z1 must preserve the crossover measured here. Retention does not imply birth.

on_failure.report_as: a failure of this response oracle on this niche
forbidden_responses: retuning thresholds, the step budget, or the injector after seeing results
selecting the best of the three O1 seeds
swapping in a metric that separates better
legitimate_next_moves: a different exposure mechanism (G0-prefix handoff training) under a NEW preregistration
the runner-up context carrier_mostly_unescorted, which inherits no part of C1's confirmation and needs a brand-new protocol on fresh data

prohibited: training O1 on POD_DEFEND_LEAD or any other V6I26 phase pod
scoring any gate on injected episodes
naming O1's behaviour before observing it
birthing z1 before all four gates pass
training the router before >= 2 branches are retained
changing any constant in this document after the freeze commit
freeze_record: the commit introducing this file together with experiments/c1_context.py, tests/test_c1_context.py and docs/o1-response-oracle-preregistration.md; no O1 training data existed at that commit
